* Weight management can be an issue for winter athletes. Some
lose weight easily because of the demand for calories and limited access
to food. Just how many times are you willing to remove your gloves to
unpack, unwrap, and eat snacks?) Yet, other winter athletes gain weight.
Long nights of darkness offer plenty of time to eat excessively. To limit
winter weight gain, stay active! Exercise helps manage health, weight,
and the winter blues.

© The tricks to enjoying exercising in winter are to invest in proper
clothing, fuel adequately, and prevent dehydration.

Winter Recovery Foods
